## Historical implementation and proposals

The [compiler design and source-layout archive](history/compiler.qmd) preserves compiler migration records and source-layout contracts with provenance. The [program and campaign archive](history/programs.qmd) preserves dated program plans, contracts, audits, and evidence narratives under purpose-based names. The [2026-10-28 implementation snapshot](https://github.com/tumlinso/Cellerator/blob/main/docs/history/current_implementation_2026-10-28.qmd) retains detailed dated capability and experiment notes. Its historical entry includes a correction pointing to the final prepared-routing receipt. The [CelleraTorch archive](history/celleratorch.qmd) preserves the former component material and the later paused runtime proposal. Neither proposal represents an implemented package.

Historical planning, Todo state, and branch-preservation records remain under their existing project-control owners. They are not duplicated here. Original source-bound reports and receipts remain unchanged; use their recorded source, workload, and validation boundaries when interpreting results.
